description: This file defines the 'Column' class used for managing report header columns in the OrangeHRM project, including properties such as 'name', 'property', 'pin', 'size', and 'cellProperties', along with methods for setting, getting, and converting these properties to an array.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a report header column with properties like name, property identifier, pin position, size, and cell properties, providing methods for property management and array serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Column object with the specified property.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the column if set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the column.

methods.name: getProp
methods.description: Returns the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: getPin
methods.description: Returns the pin position of the column ('colPinStart', 'colPinEnd', or null).

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets the pin position of the column, validating the input.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the column.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the column.

methods.name: getCellProperties
methods.description: Returns the cell properties array for the column.

methods.name: setCellProperties
methods.description: Sets the cell properties for the column.

methods.name: addCellProperties
methods.description: Merges additional cell properties into the existing cell properties array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the column's properties as an associative array.
